sentences.japanese: 記念式典は閉会の辞で幕を閉じた。
sentences.english: The commemorative ceremony ended with the closing address.

sentences.japanese: 学校を辞めるなんて彼はなんてばかだ。
sentences.english: What a fool he is to leave school.

sentences.japanese: 我々の至上命題はこの紛争にすっぱりと終止符を打つことであって、そのために妥協点を探ることも辞さない。
sentences.english: Our top priority is to settle this dispute once and for all, so we are ready to meet them halfway.

sentences.japanese: 家族がいなければ、私はこの仕事を辞めるだろう。
sentences.english: If it were not for my family, I would give up this job.

sentences.japanese: やむなく学校を辞めさせられた。
sentences.english: I was compelled to leave school.
